references.text: Parallel text that also commands all men to appear before the Lord God three times a year
Repeats the command that all men shall appear in the presence of the Lord three times a year at the three major festivals
Explains the three annual festivals (Passover, Weeks, and Tabernacles) where all men were to appear before the Lord
Introduces the command regarding the three annual festivals that Israel was to celebrate for the Lord
Detailed description of the Lord's feasts that Israel was to observe throughout the year
The Feast of Weeks (Pentecost) gathered Jews in Jerusalem, one of the three pilgrimage festivals
Prophetic expansion that transforms the three annual festivals into continuous worship in the new age.
